## Summary

Apply the manuscript critique to the chapters: thirty-three of the fifty-eight
open ledger rows land in the Book, across eight chapter sources, the seams, the
front matter and the appendices. Two theorem statements gain hypotheses they were
leaning on unnamed, and one section title is withdrawn rather than hedged.

## Test Plan

Book built with tectonic and the changed pages read at 1.0×. 562 pages,
9.42 MiB, zero undefined references and zero undefined citations in the log.
Three defects were found only by building and looking, and all three are fixed:
a bad chapter-reference key caught in the log, an equation 142.1pt over the
measure, and a table whose narrowest content had the widest column.

Pages inspected at 1.0×: 44, 49, 64–65, 100, 109, 145, 178, 195, 251, 310, 341,
373, 396, 6, 536, 537.

## Visual Proof

Rendered pages were inspected at 1.0× and the three defects found are described
in the Test Plan above. Pages read: 44, 49 (the new theorem), 64–65 (the
durability boundary), 195 (the split equation), 536 (the ownership table).
